summary: @or-sdk/source-api preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and immediately invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js],...)` to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript payload (hex-mangled identifiers, shuffled string-array with rotating shuffle function, custom string decoder), executed under an alternate runtime that Node-based tooling and reviewers do not analyze — the alternate-runtime dropper pattern. The `@or-sdk` scope corresponds to an internal OneReach namespace (`gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next` per CHANGELOG.md), so this publicly-published package under the same scope is positioned to hit developers or CI that resolve `@or-sdk/*` from the public npm registry rather than an internal mirror — a dependency-confusion / scope-squat vector. The combination of scope-squat lure, alternate-runtime execution vector, and heavily obfuscated install-time payload conceals the executed behavior from install-time review and hands arbitrary code execution to the payload on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
